mapper.sql: SELECT plan_id, plan_name, calc_base, plan_type, base_ratio, bonus_threshold, bonus_ratio, plan_status, locked, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM biz_hr_commission_plan
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_hr_commission_plan (plan_name, calc_base, plan_type, base_ratio, bonus_threshold, bonus_ratio, plan_status, locked, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{planName}, #{calcBase}, #{planType}, #{baseRatio}, #{bonusThreshold}, #{bonusRatio}, '0', '0', '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update:
UPDATE biz_hr_commission_plan plan_name = #{planName}, calc_base = #{calcBase}, plan_type = #{planType}, base_ratio = #{baseRatio}, bonus_threshold = #{bonusThreshold}, bonus_ratio = #{bonusRatio}, plan_status = #{planStatus}, locked = #{locked}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark},
WHERE plan_id = #{planId}
mapper.delete: UPDATE biz_hr_commission_plan SET del_flag = '2' WHERE plan_id IN #{planId}
mapper.select: SELECT tier_id, plan_id, min_amount, max_amount, ratio FROM biz_hr_commission_tier WHERE plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY min_amount
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_hr_commission_tier (plan_id, min_amount, max_amount, ratio) VALUES (#{planId}, #{minAmount}, #{maxAmount}, #{ratio})
mapper.sql: SELECT bill_id, period, employee_id, employee_name, plan_id, plan_name, calc_base, base_amount, commission_amount, bill_status, confirmer, confirm_time, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark FROM biz_hr_commission_bill
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_hr_commission_bill (period, employee_id, employee_name, plan_id, plan_name, calc_base, base_amount, commission_amount, bill_status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{period}, #{employeeId}, #{employeeName}, #{planId}, #{planName}, #{calcBase}, #{baseAmount}, #{commissionAmount}, '0', '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update:
UPDATE biz_hr_commission_bill commission_amount = #{commissionAmount}, bill_status = #{billStatus}, confirmer = #{confirmer}, confirm_time = #{confirmTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark},
WHERE bill_id = #{billId}
mapper.delete: UPDATE biz_hr_commission_bill SET del_flag = '2' WHERE period = #{period} AND bill_status = '0'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM biz_hr_commission_bill WHERE period = #{period} AND bill_status = '2' AND del_flag = '0'
